answer: Require each identity to escrow a 920-unit bond and serve a 39-epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for nineteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 920 units per alias and replays thirty-nine rounds, while a canyon of matched traces exposes the ring, signal rotation scatters tasks, and pearl-sealed receipts certify reviews.
